title: Laser Scanning Path Engine
summary: FPGA-based scan engine that drives galvo mirrors and a piezo stage for laser scanning microscopy. Computes kinematically correct raster trajectories in real time, with uni/bidirectional scanning, XY/XZ/YZ/XYZ planes, configurable laser line patterns, and 20-bit DAC output.

title: STED Image Reconstruction Software
summary: End-to-end acquisition and reconstruction pipeline for STED microscopy. Reads raw detector signals, handles photon counting and time-gating, and assembles super-resolution images in real time during acquisition.

title: FPGA Scan & Detection Controller
summary: Real-time FPGA control system for microscope scanning paths, laser pulse detection, and beam enable logic. Sub-microsecond timing for synchronizing excitation and depletion lasers.

title: Custom Opto-Mechanical Assemblies
summary: Precision optical mounts, beam path assemblies, and mechanical fixtures designed for custom STED and confocal microscope setups. Toleranced for thermal stability and vibration isolation.
